scope: apps/web/src consumer points minus components/ui/ (#1054/#1055, ADR 0012 D1). Two ledgers in one review face. squareBoxes: every line the shape gate flags (visible square box: bare rounded-none + unconditional paint, or enclosing border + fill with no radius declared) must match an entry {file, anchor, kind, basis?, reason} — anchor = literal substring of the flagged line. kind deviation = deliberate non-registry geometry with reason; kind rides-primitive = radius comes through from the underlying registry component (basis names it); kind state-surface = state tint painted over an already-ruled box (line-level scan cannot see the base class). brandInkText: every consumer text-role use of the brand ink (--card-button/--focus-ring as text-(...) or CSS color:) must match an entry {file, anchor, role, reason, contrast} — role in selection-mark | indicator | badge-glyph | action-link (#987: brand ink is spot emphasis only, never body/label/button-text ink; action-link = the board card accent text link, DESIGN.md 按钮). Solid-fill (bg-) uses are the slot's canonical role and are not policed. Full disposition inventory incl. wave-1 attribution: docs/spec/27-consumer-surface-shapes-and-brand-ink-ledger.md.

squareBoxes.reason: Coordinator settings Model and machine row: a full-width Button deep-link inside the settings card. The Button's transparent border would hide the card's divide-y rule on a multi-row card, and a radius on the button would curl the card corners, so the box stays square. The card's --radius-card corners stay the visible shape.

ResourceRow button form (#1416): a full-width Button row inside the settings card. It draws the row divider itself because the Button's transparent border hides the card's divide-y rule (last:border-b-0 keeps the last row clean), and a divider on a rounded box would curl up at both ends, so the box stays square. The card's --radius-card corners stay the visible shape.

Phone sidebar drawer: a full-height Dialog panel pinned to the left screen edge, as on claude.ai mobile. Its top, left and bottom edges sit on the viewport edge, where rounded corners would leave slivers of the page showing, so the box stays square; the sidebar inside keeps its own surface.

Coordinator memory list row: a full-width Button between hairline dividers with no card, as in the Claude Code project memory page. The hover fill must cover the whole row edge to edge (V21), and a radius would leave rounded fill corners against the square dividers, so the box stays square.
Divided list row inside a ListCard: the card owns the radius and clips the rows, and a per-row radius would break the full-width dividers between scheduled tasks (prototype A Scheduled screen).

brandInkText.reason: PHASE_STATUS ink for the three needs-you phases (icon + 失败/确认/审核), read by the detail top bar (paper-redesign-plan PR 7) and the project page task rows and cards (#1397).
